u07-rem-close.resolution: Checked each flag against the Greek; none is a meaning error. Jeremiah 1:5 (Πρὸ τοῦ με πλάσαι σε ἐν κοιλίᾳ ἐπίσταμαί σε), Job 10:9 (Πηλόν με ἔπλασας), Psalm 142 (143):3, Leviticus 18:5, 2 Timothy 2:7 and 1 Corinthians 15 identify words the commentary quotes while explaining Ps 118; the fragment headings are the lemmata. 'God who gave them life' renders θεοῦ τοῦ ζωοποιήσαντος with its referent supplied. Εἰ μὴ ἔστιν ἀνάστασις νεκρῶν is conditional 'if there is no resurrection of the dead', as rendered. The rest are particles, participle/finite and aspect style.
